newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: South Korea President arrives in Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: South Korea President arrives in Malaysia.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam arrived on Tuesday for a three-day visit to Malaysia, aimed at boosting trade and diplomatic ties, officials said.

Kim, accompanied by his wife and members of his Cabinet and South Korea's business community, flew in from Manila after attending the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, the officials said.
An official welcoming ceremony was scheduled to be held later on Tuesday at Parliament Square and Malaysian King Tuanku Ja'afar is expected to host a state dinner.
Kim is scheduled to lunch with Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad on Wednesday and hold bilateral talks with him soon after, before leaving for home on Thursday.
